public_rationale: The records establish neither numerical threshold. An earlier deployment model estimates a relatively small staging share, NVIDIA describes strong utilization, and later reporting describes Amazon receiving hardware before deployment. These facts can coexist. None measures both worldwide installed Hopper share and uninstalled Blackwell packages during the target period.
limitations: The deployment model concerns an earlier period and contains estimates.
Utilization measures available compute, not all hardware shipped.
Amazon evidence is secondary reporting about one operator.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The author thinks it is reasonable to believe that the majority, if not all, of Hopper GPUs are installed, which leaves millions of Blackwell GPUs waiting to be installed.
conditions: I think it's reasonable to believe

statement.excerpt: I think it’s reasonable to believe that the majority — if not the entirety — of Hopper GPUs are installed, leaving us with millions of Blackwell GPUs waiting to be installed.

from_speaker: I think it’s reasonable to believe
the majority — if not the entirety — of Hopper GPUs are installed
millions of Blackwell GPUs waiting to be installed
our_interpretation: Assess the factual inference, while retaining the author's expressed uncertainty. This is not a conditional forecast.
Majority means more than half of shipped Hopper GPUs. Entirety is an optional stronger possibility, not the minimum commitment.
Millions means at least two million physical Blackwell GPU packages, excluding consumer graphics cards. Installed means installed in a powered data center and ready for use.
For this ongoing observation, use the latest calendar reporting window before publication: July 1 through September 22, 2026. Counts must refer to a common snapshot within that window.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable shipment and deployment records establish both that more than half of shipped Hopper GPUs were installed and that at least two million shipped Blackwell packages remained uninstalled.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish that at most half of shipped Hopper GPUs were installed, or that fewer than two million shipped Blackwell packages remained uninstalled.
